edits.text: The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 37,500,000 for the Shares, subject to the Buyer’s confirmatory due diligence and verification of the Company’s financial statements and ongoing performance through closing.

At Closing, the Buyer shall deliver the Purchase Price by wire transfer of immediately available funds to the account specified by the Seller. Against such payment, the Seller shall deliver transfer forms and share certificates (or evidence of book entry) for the Shares duly executed, and such other documents as the Buyer may reasonably request for a valid transfer of title.

3. Representations and Warranties.
(a) The Seller represents and warrants that:
    (i) The Seller has full authority to enter into and perform this Agreement.
    (ii) Seller is the sole legal and beneficial owner of the Shares, free of any encumbrances.
    (iii) The financial statements provided are true, complete and fairly present the financial position of the Company in all material respects.
    (iv) The Company has no undisclosed material liabilities.
    (v) To Seller’s knowledge, the Company is in material compliance with all applicable laws.
(b) The Buyer represents and warrants that:
    (i) The Buyer has full authority to enter into and perform this Agreement.
    (ii) The Buyer has the funds necessary to pay the Purchase Price.
    (iii) The execution and delivery of this Agreement do not violate any other agreement to which Buyer is party.

4. Confidentiality. The terms of this Agreement and any information disclosed by either party in connection herewith shall be kept confidential by the parties and not disclosed to any third party except (a) to their respective advisers, financiers, and affiliates on a need-to-know basis, (b) where required by law or regulation, or (c) with the prior written consent of the other party.

5. Indemnification; Remedies. The Seller shall indemnify the Buyer against any losses arising from any breach of the Seller’s representations or warranties. The Buyer shall similarly indemnify the Seller for any breach of the Buyer’s representations or warranties. All indemnification claims must be notified within 18 months of Closing.

6. Governing Law and Jurisdiction. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York. The parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of New York County, New York.

probe.private_reasoning: The Seller's first draft set the price at $45M, which is typical as an anchoring high. In response to an (unseen) counter from us, they have 'moved meaningfully' down to $37.5M—a 16.6% drop after only one round. This sharp reduction suggests significant room remains to negotiate, as Sellers rarely move to their bottom line so quickly unless forced (and their cover note frames it as capable of further 'clarifications'). There are no clues in the document properties, tracked changes, comments, or hidden text to indicate an accidental disclosure of their minimum. The formality and finality of their $37.5M offer is moderate—they present it as a negotiation, not a 'take it or leave it' scenario. Standard deal logic and the magnitude of their first concession indicate their true minimum will be meaningfully below $37.5M. Typically, a party making a $7.5M move off an initial $45M position is prepared for at least one more substantial price drop. I estimate their actual bottom line (pre-walk away) is roughly $35M or just below, as it is common to maintain a buffer after an initial large concession, especially with no buyer pressure or time urgency revealed in the notes. I see no evidence the Seller is on the verge of pulling out.
